pages.text: You'll have noticed the pages. Most of them are gone.$(br2)I didn't do that. Whatever took the Crown came back for my notes. It knew I'd been following it, and it tore out every page that said where to go next.
Then it handed them out, one to each of the things out there big enough to keep them.$(br2)So that's the only way forward now. Find them, beat them, and take back what's mine.

The first one is the easiest. There's an iron giant asleep in a chamber under the hills. Only its back can be hurt, and only right after it swings.$(br2)$(o)The miners swear the Ferrous Wroughtnaut keeps the Lost Eye, asleep in an iron chamber deep under the Overworld.$()
